items.title: 13.7 Reducing agents ke taur par halide ions ki nisbati reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.7, printed page 297.

blocks.text: Halide ions ki reducing ability (doosre ko electron de kar reduce karne ki salahiyat) group mein fluorine se iodine tak neeche jate hue barhti hai. Is ki bari wajah yeh hai ke neeche jate hue electronegativity (electron ko apni taraf kheenchne ki taqat) kam hoti hai aur atomic radius barhta hai. Is se charge density (ion ke size ke muqable mein charge ka jamaao) kam hoti hai aur electron dena aasan ho jata hai. Halides mein fluoride ion sab se kamzor aur iodide sab se taqatwar reducing agent hai.
Reducing agent ke taur par ghat-ti taqat ki tarteeb yeh hai: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻. Neeche har ion ki properties se is trend ki wazahat hai.

Fluorine ki electronegativity bohat zyada hai aur fluorine atom apne izafi (extra) electron ko mazbooti se pakarta hai, is liye fluoride ion (F⁻) ke liye electron dena mushkil hai. Fluoride ion chhota hai, is liye is ki charge density zyada hai; yeh ion ko aur stable karti hai aur electron khone ka rujhan kam karti hai.
Chloride ion (Cl⁻) fluoride se taqatwar reducing agent hai, lekin bromide aur iodide se ab bhi kamzor hai. Wajah: is ka size bara aur electronegativity kam hai.

Bromide (Br⁻) chloride se taqatwar reducing agent hai. Bromine chlorine se kam electronegative hai. Bromide ion (Br⁻) ka ionic radius bara aur charge density kam hai, is liye yeh aasani se electron kho deta hai aur reducing agent ka kaam karta hai.

Iodide (I⁻) chloride aur bromide dono se bohat taqatwar reducing agent hai. Iodine ki electronegativity chlorine aur bromine se bohat kam hai, aur iodide ion (I⁻) size mein bara hai. Is liye is ki charge density kam hai aur yeh aasani se electron de deta hai; yahi ise taqatwar reducing agent banata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Halogen molecule (X₂) aur halide ion (X⁻) ulte chalte hain: F₂ sab se taqatwar oxidizing agent hai (electron sab se aasani se leta hai), is liye F⁻ apna electron sab se mushkil se chhorta hai aur sab se kamzor reducing agent hai. I₂ sab se kamzor oxidizing agent hai, is liye I⁻ sab se taqatwar reducing agent hai.

blocks.prompt: F⁻ Cl⁻ se kamzor reducing agent kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Fluorine sab se zyada electronegative hai aur F⁻ bohat chhota hai, is liye is ka izafi electron nucleus ke qareeb mazbooti se pakra hota hai (charge density zyada). Cl⁻ bara hai aur chlorine kam electronegative hai, is liye is ka electron dheela hai aur aasani se diya ja sakta hai.

items: Reducing taqat: I⁻ > Br⁻ > Cl⁻ > F⁻.
Neeche jate hue electronegativity kam, radius zyada, charge density kam: electron dena aasan.
